name: Toubun Ice Float
source:
Usagi Sumie, who advocates philanthropy, spends his time trying to be kind to everyone. The accumulation of small kindness was rumored to be Our Lady even in the school. Even today, I came to the front of the station to go out with my friends Souta and Kafuka after school, but suddenly we developed a romantic relationship ...
